# Lessons Skill

Diff comparison of final generated drafts vs. published pieces, capturing learnings into `voice/<active-voice>/content-lessons.md`.

## Triggers
- "run lessons"
- "learn from this piece"
- "step 6"
- "what did we learn?"

## Instructions
1. Read `engine/4-lessons-loop.md`.
2. Compare the final draft at `drafts/<piece>/draft.html` against the published copy.
3. Classify differences (editorial adjustments, voice refinements, structural changes).
4. Propose concise, actionable lessons.
5. Upon confirmation, append lessons to `voice/<active-voice>/content-lessons.md`.
